requirement.original: File download support entirely absent from the app. No download button, save icon, or download link exists anywhere for code blocks or file content. Major gap vs Claude Desktop/ChatGPT/Gemini. Server has GET /files/* route but no UI triggers downloads.
requirement.clarified: Add a Download button next to the existing Copy button in markdown code blocks. On web, use HTML5 blob download (no server needed). Derive filename from code language (e.g., code.py, code.ts). Follow the same hover-to-reveal pattern as the Copy button.
requirement.what: Add download button to code blocks in MarkdownView
requirement.why: Feature parity with competing products (Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, Gemini) -- users cannot save code snippets as files

excluded: Download for non-code content (tables, images, plain text)

success_criteria: Download button appears next to Copy button on code block hover (web)
Clicking Download saves a file with correct extension based on language
Unknown/missing language falls back to .txt extension
Empty code blocks do not show download button
constraints: Must use t() for all user-visible strings
Must follow existing hover pattern (onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave + className)
Use Modal.alert for feedback, never Alert from react-native

root_cause_analysis.symptom: No download button exists anywhere in the app for code blocks or file content
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Users cannot save code snippets from sessions as files, forcing manual copy-paste into editors

research_findings.reason: Straightforward UI feature with clear implementation pattern (blob download) already well-established in the codebase's Copy button pattern

context.codebase_state: MarkdownView.tsx has a RenderCodeBlock component (lines 161-207) with a Copy button that uses hover-to-reveal pattern. No download functionality exists anywhere.
context.recent_commits: No relevant commits -- feature never existed

file_contents.server_file_route: packages/happy-server/sources/app/api/routes/fileRoutes.ts (GET /files/* -- serves local/S3 files, NOT needed for code block download)

development_approach.strategy: Add Download button inside the existing hover wrapper in RenderCodeBlock, using client-side blob download. Create a language-to-extension mapping. Add i18n strings.
development_approach.validation_approach: Build happy-app web, verify code blocks show Download button on hover, verify clicking triggers browser file download with correct filename/extension, verify translations render in all languages
